title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: monitor agents (Worldwide)
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, default agent monitoring, licensing statements and investigation permissions are supported. The policy navigation reaches the correct details page, but the table should include the documented Edit policy step for custom-policy updates while retaining its caveat about the default policy.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management monitors AI agents as well as users.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management enables organizations to identify, investigate, and respond to potential insider risks across users and agents.
